verdict.rationale: Paystack is an API-first payments platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The cited docs cover only general API usage, test/live keys, pagination, and error metadata.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
